content:
Longtime fan of the show, and I wanted to reach out about a strange encounter I had back in 2017. Unfortunately, it wasn’t a Sasquatch encounter, but whatever I saw was definitely something I still can’t explain.

I live in southern New Hampshire, in a pretty rural area. There are a lot of heavily wooded areas around here, and I live right next to a huge nature preserve. At the time, I was a junior in high school, and my girlfriend lived in the next town over, about 15 minutes away.

There was a connecting road between the two towns that, at the time, only had maybe four or five houses along it. It was extremely wooded, with dense forest on both sides and absolutely no streetlights. It was basically just a long road cutting straight through the woods.

One night, I was driving home from my girlfriend’s house. The road was about four miles long, and I was probably two-thirds of the way down when something stepped out into the road in front of me.

It was very tall, maybe 9 feet, skinny and lanky, and you could see the ribs of it, almost like how a bats skin is sucked into to its bones. It was a dark dark brown, greyish color. The way I describe it to people is, when you leave a hotdog cooking too long in an oven and it gets crispy, wrinkly, and has that burnt color.

That’s what the texture and color of its skin was. It took two steps across the road, and flew up over the brush on the opposite side. The brush was about 8ft tall, so not something a standard animal or person could do. It did however have wings. And I remember it just doing one giant flap and then flying upward over the brush. It had long skinny legs and arms, and the feet, although I didn’t get a great look at them, seemed to be webbed like a frog or a duck. Really not sure what I could have seen. But its engraved into my head almost 10 years later.
